title: Clinical Language Explanation & Result communication with AI
summary: The CLEAR_AI study investigates whether artificial intelligence (AI) can complement traditional physician–patient communication. A total of 80 patients undergoing catheter ablation for cardiac arrhythmias will have the opportunity to interact with an AI-powered robotic system following their procedure. The system explains individual treatment results and answers medical questions in an understandable manner. Participants subsequently complete questionnaires evaluating their experience. A telephone follow-up is conducted after eight weeks. The study aims to assess feasibility, usability, patient satisfaction, and the perceived benefits of AI-assisted patient education.
conditions: Atrial fibrillation and atrial flutter, unspecified

interventions.name: Following catheter ablation, all participants receive an additional interaction of up to 30 minutes with a locally operated, AI-powered robotic system to explain their medical condition and treatment results, alongside standard medical care. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Catheter ablation for an atrial arrhythmia; written informed consent; sufficient German language proficiency; adequate cognitive and clinical stability following the procedure to interact with the AI system (physician assessment).
Exclusion criteria:
Insufficient German language proficiency; impaired capacity to provide informed consent; severe cognitive impairment or other conditions preventing meaningful interaction with the AI system.
